'''''Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path''''' is a young reader novel by [[Jude Watson]] and the sixth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' series. The book was first released by [[Scholastic]] in [[February]] [[2000]]. It is set in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] prior to [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TERC" />
